claims.claim_vi: The source names three components: a location service recording user location updates sent every few seconds (used to detect new and closed roads, improve map accuracy, feed live traffic); map rendering that projects the world into tiles served from a CDN backed by cloud storage, with pre-calculated tiles per zoom level; a navigation service that calls a geocoding service and a route planner (top-K shortest paths, time estimate from current and historical traffic, ranking by predicted time and user filters).
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: The source states one billion daily active users as of March 2021 and 99 percent world coverage; the lesson does not repeat these.
claims.verified_by: Not checked against any primary document; deliberately omitted.

claims.claim_vi: Own calculation, 2026-10-19, Python 3: with the common web-map tiling scheme where each zoom level splits every tile into four, zoom 0 has 1 tile, zoom 5 has 1,024, zoom 10 has 1,048,576, zoom 15 has 1,073,741,824 and zoom 18 has 68,719,476,736; the sum for zooms 0 to 15 is 1,431,655,765, which at an assumed 15 thousand bytes per tile is about 21 terabytes; Hanoi at 21.0285 N, 105.8542 E maps to tile (813, 450) at zoom 10 and (26019, 14425) at zoom 15.
claims.section: Thử nghiệm: số ô bản đồ
claims.verified_by: Script run in the session; the tile scheme and the coordinate formula are the author's general knowledge, author's general knowledge, not checked against the primary document in this session (the egress proxy allows github only).

claims.claim_vi: Own experiment, Python 3: on a 40 by 40 grid with seeded random edge lengths, Dijkstra plus Yen's algorithm found three shortest routes of lengths 61.65, 61.67, 61.68 between two corner nodes; tripling the cost of the middle third of the first route made travel times 101.23, 101.25 and 97.57, so the third route became the fastest.
claims.section: Thử nghiệm: tuyến ngắn nhất và tuyến nhanh nhất
claims.verified_by: Script run in the session with a fixed seed; results copied from output.

design_notes_vi: Khung một là ba thành phần; khung hai là ba điều rút ra từ tính toán. Con số dung lượng dựa trên giả định.
source_deviations: The source gives structure only; the lesson adds a tile-count calculation (with an assumed tile size) and a route experiment on a synthetic grid.
The source's user-count and coverage figures are not repeated because they could not be checked.
